recipes.label: Fury of the Wolf
recipes.startdescription: As the god of unmaking and agony, the Wolf-Divided intended to spread the flames of annihilation throughout the entire world during the great war - and he would definitely not accept being imprisoned or bound by fate. We must confront his rage head-on.

recipes.startdescription: The long and terrifying torment finally came to an end, and the Hour of unmaking had been weakened to its limit -

recipes.label: Wounds of the Wolf
recipes.startdescription:
The indescribable agony was boiling within me. The most vile part of myself emerged from the invisible wound and merged with the Wolf's carcass -

[Warning! If you still have untreated wounds, this could very likely kill you.]
recipes.description: This wound was extremely deep, and the pain was even more intense than the act of self-dividing. But in order to welcome back the old Sun, this was a sacrifice that had to be made.

recipes.label: Blood of an Immortal God?
recipes.startdescription:
The Wolf Divided once again fought fiercely within the cage of glass and light, with a deafening roar! But his claws also loosened up a little bit. If I could gather enough strength -

[Satisfy any threshold to attempt to cause damage to the Wolf, but all Allies involved will be killed.]

In the blindingly painful light, the shape of Wolf-Divided distorted into a nightmare composed of countless sharp teeth and thorns, each part overflowing with the intent of slaughter and destruction -

[Failing to defend will permanently damage your ability cards.All Allies involved will be killed.]

recipes.label: Respond with Force
recipes.startdescription:
I summoned all the deadly lessons within my body, mind and soul, forming a barrier against the force of annihilation - each time the Wolf tores, it was like a hundred poisons gnawing at the heart... But that was just pain; the Wolf could no longer cause any further harm.

[All Allies involved will be killed.]

I summoned all the unceasing strength within my body, mind and soul, forming a barrier against the force of annihilation - each time the Wolf tores, it was like a hundred poisons gnawing at the heart... But that was just pain; the Wolf could no longer cause any further harm.

[All Allies involved will be killed.]

recipes.label: Enmity for Eternity
recipes.startdescription:
The enmity of the Wolf Divided transformed into an insidious, bone-chilling coldness. The roaring frost and snow were relentlessly devouring all the life in this place - before all things could reach their predetermined end, this overwhelming hatred would never cease.

[Failing to defend will permanently damage your ability cards.All Allies involved will be killed.]

recipes.label: Respond with Endurance
recipes.startdescription:
The world is still as ice, and I pondered the ending lessons here: everything has its end, and those who understand patience are the most enduring. Therefore, my soul did not yield to the ancient enmity.

[All Allies involved will be killed.]

recipes.label: Respond with Flame
recipes.startdescription:
The world is still as ice, and here I unleashed the most intense flames: Everything has an end, but change never ceases, and an end cannot come. Therefore, my body and mind did not yield to the ancient enmity.

[All Allies involved will be killed.]

The roar of the ships shook the sea, the expanding flames tore through the sky - the downfall of this city was only a matter of time.
